definitions.explanation: Describes the quality of having many different kinds or forms. Used for cultures, lifestyles, opinions, species, and other things with wide variety.

examples.japanese: {多様|たよう}な{文化|ぶんか}を{尊重|そんちょう}する。
{働|はたら}き{方|かた}が{多様|たよう}になってきた。
examples.english: Work styles have become more diverse.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}には{多様|たよう}な{動植物|どうしょくぶつ}が{生息|せいそく}しており、{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}の{注目|ちゅうもく}を{集|あつ}めている。
examples.english: A diverse range of plants and animals inhabit this region, attracting researchers' attention.

notes:
{多様|たよう} is a na-adjective and noun describing variety and diversity.

FORMS:
- Modifier: {多様|たよう}な + noun
- Noun: {多様|たよう}{性|せい} (diversity)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多様|たよう}な{価値観|かちかん}: diverse values
- {多様|たよう}な{意見|いけん}: varied opinions
- {多様|たよう}{性|せい}: diversity (very common compound)
- {多様|たよう}{化|か}: diversification
- {生物|せいぶつ}{多様|たよう}{性|せい}: biodiversity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {様々|さまざま}: emphasizes individual differences among items ("various, all sorts of")
- {多様|たよう}: emphasizes the overall quality of having variety ("diverse")
- {多彩|たさい}: emphasizes richness and colorfulness of variety
